verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no public pricing page and no documented per-plan storage quotas, per-user prices, or over-quota behavior. Community remarks about free storage amounts and running out of space are anecdotal and are not published pricing. Storage pricing is a fair axis for a cloud storage product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a founder, storage pricing is published — per-plan storage quotas and per-user prices on a public page, including what happens at the cap
